data.one_liner: An offline-first NoSQL document database with SQL++ queries, full-text search, and bi-directional sync.
data.what_it_does: It provides an embedded NoSQL database for Dart and Flutter applications across multiple platforms. It supports SQL++ queries, live reactive queries, full-text search, and peer-to-peer or server data synchronization.
use_when: You need an offline-first NoSQL database with complex querying capabilities.
You require bi-directional data synchronization with Couchbase Server or peer-to-peer devices.
You want reactive live queries that update automatically when data changes.
avoid_when: You only need a simple key-value store or lightweight local SQLite database.
You are looking for a standard cloud backend without local offline database requirements.
strengths: Supports robust offline-first functionality and local data persistence.
Offers bi-directional and peer-to-peer data sync features.
Includes powerful SQL++ query support and live queries.
weaknesses: Features like vector search, peer-to-peer sync, and encryption require the Enterprise Edition.
Involves complex native tooling and FFI setup compared to pure Dart key-value stores.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml. Community edition is default, while Enterprise edition requires configuration under hooks in pubspec.yaml.

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick if you prefer a traditional local SQLite relational database instead of a NoSQL document database.

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick if you want a type-safe reactive SQLite database builder for Flutter.

alternatives.name: shared_preferences
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick if you only need a simple key-value store for preferences instead of a full document database.
